mapper.select: SELECT * FROM app_user ORDER BY id ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO app_user (username, nickname, phone, email, role, status, bio) VALUES (#{item.username}, #{item.nickname}, #{item.phone}, #{item.email}, #{item.role}, #{item.status}, #{item.bio})
mapper.update: UPDATE app_user SET nickname = #{item.nickname}, phone = #{item.phone}, email = #{item.email}, role = #{item.role}, status = #{item.status}, bio = #{item.bio} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM app_user WHERE username = #{username} LIMIT 1
